identity.name: Divine Leadership Press
identity.vibe: Hundred-year-old publishing house meets Silicon Valley precision. Heritage, Authority, Craftsmanship, Innovation.

core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix 19th-century book design with 21st-century SaaS utility.
Content is King: The interface recedes; the manuscript takes center stage.
Tactile Digitalism: Use texture (grain, paper) and lighting to make the screen feel like a physical object.
Negative Space: Luxurious margins. If it feels empty, add more space, not more content.
anti_patterns: No 'Inter' for headings. Use characterful Serifs.
No flat, soulless gradients. Use noise/grain or deep, rich solids.
No clutter. Every element must earn its place.

headings.usage: All H1-H3 headings, Hero text, Feature titles.

body.usage: UI elements, buttons, navigation, dashboard data.

editor.usage: The actual manuscript writing area. Essential for the 'book' feel.

rules: Overlines/Labels must be Uppercase + tracking-widest (0.2em) + text-xs.
Editor text should have relaxed line-height (1.8) for readability.

colors.mode_strategy: Smart Hybrid (Light for Writing/Reading, Dark for Dashboard/Focus)
usage_notes: Primary color is a deep Amber/Bronze (#B45309 in hex approx), evoking leather bindings and gold leaf.
Background in light mode is NOT pure white. Use a very subtle warm off-white to mimic paper.
Text is never pure black. Use #1A1A1A or deep charcoal.

layout.spacing_system: Generous. Use p-8, p-12, p-16. Don't cram.

grid_strategy.dashboard: Bento Grid (Mode B). Dense, data-rich but with elegant borders.
grid_strategy.marketing: Tetris Grid (Mode A). Asymmetrical, artistic, overlapping elements.
grid_strategy.editor: Focus Column. Single central column, max-width-3xl, massive side margins.

buttons.style: Sharp or slightly rounded. No pill shapes for primary actions.
buttons.animation: Hover: slight lift (-1px) + shadow-md. Active: scale-95.

cards.style: Flat with 1px border. Minimal shadow. 'Tracing Beam' effect on hover for feature cards.

inputs.style: Underlined or minimal border. No heavy backgrounds.

navigation.style: Sticky glassmorphism header. Simple text links with animated underlines.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise/grain overlays on backgrounds to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Layered shadows. shadow-sm + shadow-xl for depth.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-md with border-white/10 for overlays and sticky headers.

media.image_style: Cinematic, high-contrast, warm tones. Focus on details (hands, paper, ink).

hero.description: Open book on wooden table - Hero Background

workspace.description: Minimalist desk with coffee - User Dashboard
Laptop on wooden desk - Writing Interface

details.description: Old print press details - About/History Section

3d_libraries.usage: Interactive 3D Book Preview in Hero or Export section. Allow user to rotate the book.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. UPDATE TAILWIND: Configure the font families in tailwind.config.js as specified in typography section.
3. UPDATE CSS: Replace the root variables in index.css with the 'colors' values provided above.
4. CREATE LAYOUTS: Build the 'Bento Grid' for the dashboard and 'Focus Column' for the editor.
5. USE IMAGES: Use the provided image URLs for placeholders. DO NOT use generic placeholders.
6. CUSTOMIZE SHADCN: Override default rounded-md with rounded-sm for buttons to match the 'Sharp/Precise' aesthetic.
7. ADD TEXTURE: Create a global 'noise' overlay component using a transparent PNG or CSS pattern.
8. DATA-TESTID: Ensure every interactive element has a data-testid attribute.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid 'AI Slop' - no generic centered layouts.
Dark colors must be solid or subtle noise, NO gradients.
No 'text-align: center' on the App container.
